in_hebrew.name: Armilda
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Armilda הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Armodios', meaning 'powerful' or 'mighty'. The suffix '-ilda' is derived from 'hild', meaning 'battle' or 'soldier'. This name was popular among the Germanic peoples and was borne by several early saints.
